description: Create a new contact group containing the given contacts (by exact contact name). At least one contact is required. parent_container_name must be a Tenant/Location/Node (or the root) container, and every contact_names entry must be visible from that container's scope - use get_allowed_elements_for_container(object_type="contactgroup", container_name=...) to see which contacts qualify.

parent_container_name.description: Parent container: a Tenant, Location, Node or the root. Empty means the root.

name: create_contactgroup
title: Create Contact Group
